'''Javeezo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunter who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempCommonerRodianMale.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Possible depictions of Javeezo]]
Javeezo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].

Javeezo's appearance was randomly generated, but he always appeared as a male Rodian.

*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'' {{1st}}
